contract: GET /api/users/:id/listening-stats. A user may read their own listening statistics and an admin another user; preserve totals/time units, per-item grouping and recentSessions; forbidden/missing users deny.
exceptions: Mapping only: no tests executed in this invocation. Historical evidence is retained for provenance and does not verify this checkout; named tests are assertion leads, not exhaustive proof of every stated requirement.
Mapped tests cover selected denial or lower-level behavior only; successful endpoint payload/state and complete source/client variants need explicit owner-packet assertions.

invariants.contract: GET /api/users/:id/listening-stats returns totalTime, items (per library item time and metadata), days, dayOfWeek, today and the ten most recent sessions summed from the user playback sessions.
A user without sessions has zero stats and empty objects; after listening five seconds today, the date, weekday, item time and today show five.
401 unauthenticated; 404 unknown id for an admin; a non-admin gets 403 for other ids but 200 for its own id.
